_note: Song-level PREMISES, rebuilt 15 Oct 2026 from rap-song archetypes (ww/lex/banks/rap_archetypes.json) after Joe rejected the 14 Oct set ('the premises should be like actual rap song premises'). Assistant-authored, flagged (persona) where they go beyond the material. Each section: an ARGUMENT (a first-person boast), the rap MOVES its bars make (deflate at most one bar in eight), and the INGREDIENTS (material/ingredients.md ids) it may draw on in any order. Most Wanted is planned for the whole song; Empire and I Know a Guy are planned to a full hook so Joe can choose by ear.

premises.title: Most Wanted
premises.one_line: I'm wanted all over the world, and the rap sheet is a wanted poster for excessive energy, a gnome off a lorry and a bike in a hedge.

Hook 1-4.argument: I'm wanted in every country I've set foot in.

Hook 5-8.argument: Rotterdam wants its gnome back and I'm not giving it.

Hook 9-16.argument: They printed my face on a poster: wanted for excessive energy.

V1 1-8.argument: My crew walks in anywhere, dripping, and nobody stops us.

V1 9-16.argument: Leave me for dead in the desert and I'm back in Perth by ten.

V1 17-24.argument: I'm banned from the biggest premiere of the decade.

V1 25-32.argument: My lads move a million at a time, and the police take their cut.

V1 33-44.argument: No fixed abode: I sleep where I like and the insects pay rent.

V2 1-8.argument: Every bike I hire is a getaway vehicle.

V2 9-16.argument: I don't break the rules, I read them, and I still get in.

premises.title: Empire
premises.one_line: My empire runs on every continent, and it runs on a rail pass, a hostel bunk and two panniers.

Hook 1-4.argument: I run an operation on every continent.

Hook 5-8.argument: My statue stands in a square in Rotterdam.

Hook 9-16.argument: My jet is a rail pass, my safe house a hostel, and my stash rides in the panniers.

premises.title: I Know a Guy
premises.one_line: I've got people in every city: a bloke with a torch in the desert, a bouncer in Amsterdam, a bike shop in Hanoi.

Hook 1-4.argument: Wherever I land, I know a guy.

Hook 5-8.argument: My man in Rotterdam can get you a gnome by morning.

Hook 9-16.argument: My people: the bloke with the torch, the bouncer, the shop that never asks.
